title: LJ78 2LTE to ?________? Engine Swap
transmission: Stock Toyota LJ78 gearbox retained, mated via a custom bellhousing fabricated from a BMW bell housing
ai_summary: Forum user Rusi Rusev swapped a BMW M57 turbodiesel inline-6 (pulled complete with wiring/ECU/pedal/keys from a 2003 BMW 530D) into his Toyota LJ78 Prado, replacing the original 2L-TE. The stock Toyota gearbox was retained using a custom bellhousing built from the BMW bell, with axle ratios changed to 41/10 rear (from a 4Runner 1KZ) and 14/10 front (from an 80-series) to suit the new powerband. Owner reported 0-100km/h in about 11 seconds, 160km/h top speed, and fuel consumption of 9-11 L/100km.

complications.detail: Custom bellhousing fabricated from a BMW bell housing to mate the M57 to the stock LJ78 Toyota gearbox; radiator repositioned about 20mm forward to clear the engine
Turbo diesel charge-air cooling handled with an intercooler sourced from a Range Rover P38
Rear axle ratio changed to 41/10 (from a 4Runner 1KZ) and front to 14/10 (from an 80-series Land Cruiser) to match the M57's power delivery
Wiring kept as an intact BMW harness/ECU package - owner advised pulling the engine complete with all cables, computer, gas pedal, and keys from the donor to simplify integration
